subject: general
question:
Read the following statement carefully and identify the conclusion that follows.

Statement:

Some men are honest. All honest people are brave.

Conclusions:

I. Some men are brave.

II. All men are brave.
solution:
Given Statements:

Some men are honest.

All honest people are brave.

From statements: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dde32da424aef52ad4035f73ef02ed13b169a0502a47205515acc13d1e953f55.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some men are brave → **True** (since some men are honest and all honest are brave)

II. All men are brave → False (only some men are honest, not all)

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 1**.
